# PARTIAL COVERAGE -- READ THIS BEFORE TRUSTING A "PASS" ROW FOR AN OPCODE NOT LISTED HERE.
# This sample covers 16 of the 256 opcodes (32 files: each x2 for native/emulation mode), NOT
# all 256. The subset was chosen to exercise the width machinery (M/X context switches) and
# 65816-only addressing/instruction forms rather than to be representative of the whole ISA:
opcodes_covered: A9,A2,C0,E0,69,E9,C2,E2,FB,AF,54,44,08,28,40,22
opcodes_covered_names: A9=LDA#  A2=LDX#  C0=CPY#  E0=CPX#  69=ADC#  E9=SBC#  C2=REP  E2=SEP
  FB=XCE  AF=LDA-long  54=MVN  44=MVP  08=PHP  28=PLP  40=RTI  22=JSL
opcodes_covered_count: 16 of 256
opcodes_NOT_covered: every opcode not in the list above -- 240 of 256, including WAI (CB) and
  STP (DB), the two entries in W65816VectorHarnessSupport's NOT_APPLICABLE_OPCODES map. A row
  for an opcode outside this list simply does not exist in w65816-vector-baseline.txt; that is
  expected, not a bug -- see W65816VectorSampleTest's class doc.
full_coverage_requires: GRM_W65816_VECTORS (a full clone of
  https://github.com/SingleStepTests/65816) and `bash tools/banktest/build-and-test.sh check
  w65816-vectors`, which runs W65816VectorExhaustiveTest against all 256 opcodes x both modes.
